---
sitemap: false
---
<%#
  llms.txt: a generated, curated Markdown index of the site, following the
  emerging llms.txt convention (https://llmstxt.org) -- an H1 site name, a
  short summary, then curated link sections for LLMs/agents that fetch this
  file to get an efficient map of the site.

  The link lists below are generated from the real card collection
  (collections.cards.resources, grouped by front matter `type`) so this
  stays correct as cards are added/removed/renamed -- nothing here is
  hand-hardcoded. site.config.url anchors every link to the real production
  host (chunkybacon.dev), never localhost.

  Every link here points straight at a page's `.md` counterpart (see
  MarkdownPagesUrl, lib/markdown_pages_url.rb, and the builder that
  generates those files, plugins/builders/markdown_pages.rb) rather than
  its HTML page. llms.txt exists specifically for agents to fetch, so
  there's no reason to make them take an extra hop through HTML.
%>
<%
  # type -> [section heading, intro line] in the order we want them to appear.
  section_meta = {
    "person" => ["People", "The people who shaped Ruby."],
    "story" => ["Stories", "Moments and anecdotes from Ruby's history."],
    "talk" => ["Talks", "Conference talks worth knowing about."],
    "vocabulary" => ["Glossary", "Words and phrases you'll hear in the Ruby community."],
    "release" => ["Timeline", "Milestones in Ruby's release history."]
  }

  cards_by_type = collections.cards.resources
    .group_by { |card| card.data.type }
    .transform_values { |cards| cards.sort_by { |card| card.data.title.to_s.downcase.sub(/\A[^a-z0-9]+/, "") } }
%>
# <%== site.metadata.title %>

> <%== site.metadata.description.to_s.strip %>

Every link below is clean Markdown - no HTML markup, no site chrome. Drop the trailing `.md` (e.g. <%= site.config.url %>/people/matz/ instead of <%= site.config.url %>/people/matz.md) to browse the same page as a normal HTML page instead.

## Start Here
- [Home](<%= site.config.url %><%= MarkdownPagesUrl.relative_md_url_for_path("/") %>): <%== site.metadata.tagline %>
- [Start Here](<%= site.config.url %><%= MarkdownPagesUrl.relative_md_url_for_path("/start-here/") %>): A guided entry point into the site for first-time readers.
- [Timeline](<%= site.config.url %><%= MarkdownPagesUrl.relative_md_url_for_path("/timeline/") %>): The full timeline view, chronicling Ruby's history release by release.
- [People](<%= site.config.url %><%= MarkdownPagesUrl.relative_md_url_for_path("/people/") %>): The full roster of people covered on the site.
- [Glossary](<%= site.config.url %><%= MarkdownPagesUrl.relative_md_url_for_path("/glossary/") %>): The full glossary of Ruby community words and phrases.

<% section_meta.each do |type, (heading, intro)| %>
<% cards = cards_by_type[type] || [] %>
<% next if cards.empty? %>
## <%== heading %>

<%== intro %>

<% cards.each do |card| %>
<% hook = card.data.hook.to_s.strip %>
- [<%== card.data.title %>](<%= site.config.url %><%= MarkdownPagesUrl.relative_md_url(card) %>)<% unless hook.empty? %>: <%== hook %><% end %>
<% end %>

<% end %>
